title: Logs to metrics

fields.name: add_label
fields.description: Adds a custom label NAME and set the value to the value of KEY.

fields.name: bucket
fields.description: Optional for metric_mode histogram. If not set, default Prometheus-style buckets are used.

fields.name: discard_logs
fields.description: Flag that defines if logs should be discarded after processing. This applies for all logs, whether they have emitted metrics or not.

fields.name: emitter_mem_buf_limit
fields.description: Set a buffer limit to restrict memory usage of metrics emitter.

fields.name: emitter_name
fields.description: Name of the emitter (advanced users).

fields.name: exclude
fields.description: Excludes records in which the content of KEY matches the regular expression REGEX.

fields.name: flush_interval_nsec
fields.description: The interval for metrics emission, in nanoseconds. This parameter works in conjunction with flush_interval_sec.

fields.name: flush_interval_sec
fields.description: The interval for metrics emission, in seconds. If flush_interval_sec and flush_interval_nsec are either both unset or both set to 0, the filter emits metrics immediately after each filter match. Otherwise, if either parameter is set to a non-zero value, the filter emits metrics at the specified interval. Longer intervals help lower resource consumption in high-load situations.

fields.name: kubernetes_mode
fields.description: If enabled, adds pod_id, pod_name, namespace_name, docker_id and container_name to the metric as labels. This option is intended to be used in combination with the Kubernetes filter plugin, which fills those fields.

fields.name: label_field
fields.description: Includes a record field as label dimension in the metric.

fields.name: metric_description
fields.description: Sets a description for the metric.

fields.name: metric_mode
fields.description: Defines the mode for the metric. Valid values are counter, gauge or histogram.

fields.name: metric_name
fields.description: Sets the name of the metric.

fields.name: metric_namespace
fields.description: Sets the namespace of the metric.

fields.name: metric_subsystem
fields.description: Subsystem of the metric.

fields.name: regex
fields.description: Includes records in which the content of KEY matches the regular expression REGEX.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Defines the tag for the generated metrics record.

fields.name: value_field
fields.description: Required for modes gauge and histogram. Specifies the record field that holds a numerical value.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit filter plugin: Logs to metrics.
